title: 12 Best Art Galleries in Casablanca
description: Discover Casablanca's vibrant art scene with our top picks for galleries in 2026. From contemporary spaces to traditional Moroccan art, find your next cultural exploration.

places.name: Atelier 21
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the rotating solo and group exhibitions to discover leading contemporary Moroccan artists.

places.name: Galerie Loft
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Admire the vibrant abstract paintings and contemporary sculptures that define the gallery's modern edge.

places.name: Villa des Arts de Casablanca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Discover the historical permanent collections that showcase Moroccan cultural heritage and the regularly changing cultural events.

places.name: Galerie Matisse Art
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for pieces by celebrated Moroccan painters who have shaped the country's artistic narrative.

places.name: Espace d'Art Actua (Attijariwafa Bank)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their well-curated permanent collection and diverse temporary shows, showcasing the bank's commitment to culture.

places.name: BCK Art Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seek out their unique international collaborations and avant-garde exhibits that push artistic boundaries.

places.name: Galerie Venise Cadre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Appreciate the quality and diversity of the established artists on display, representing the core of Moroccan fine art.

places.name: Centre d'Art Contemporain de Casablanca (CAC Casablanca)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Engage with the often-interactive installations and thought-provoking performance art pieces that challenge traditional art forms.

places.name: CDG Art Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order See how Moroccan financial institutions like CDG Group contribute to and support the local art scene.

places.name: L'Atelier Photo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Marvel at the captivating visual storytelling through different photographic genres and styles on display.

places.name: Galerie Rê
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Discover up-and-coming abstract painters and sculptors who bring fresh energy to the Moroccan art scene.

places.name: Galerie H
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for vibrant paintings that capture the essence of Morocco's diverse landscapes and seascapes.
